blind.description: A freestanding crypt wall segment constructed from dark olive-green stone blocks framing an intricate ossuary facade. The center is densely filled with yellow-beige human skulls and bones arranged decoratively around an arched central niche containing a dark stone urn or canopic jar. The structure is capped with a beveled two-piece stone coping at the top and anchored by twin rectangular stone base blocks at the bottom. Both the front and back faces have identical sculpted skull arrangements and urn alcoves. Surfaces are solid, smooth-shaded, and continuous, with clean stylized relief sculpting.
blind.from_above: A flat, elongated rectangle composed of two olive-green stone capping slabs meeting at a central seam, with small hints of bone relief slightly protruding along the front and back edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 7 ft tall (about 1.2 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 ft wide.
